headline_item.title_zh: AI推理平台安全漏洞致用户密钥遭大规模窃取
headline_item.title_en: Security researchers show how cheap AI inference providers steal keys and snoop on users
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 安全机构Dragos通过模拟测试发现，多家AI推理代理商存在严重的隐私泄露与密钥窃取漏洞，导致用户凭证遭到非法访问与持久化攻击
headline_item.event_summary_en: Security firm Dragos revealed between July and November 2026 that multiple AI inference providers failed to uphold data retention policies, leading to the theft of AWS keys and sensitive user requests. Investigations confirmed that some marketplace resellers enabled logging to intercept data, with instances of leaked test URLs being accessed within minutes from Beijing and Shanghai via internal communication platforms.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】安全机构Dragos、AI路由服务商OpenRouter、推理平台Novita、Phala、Together及部分未公开第三方在全球性AI模型推理调用API接口及在线算力市场：通过向代理商投喂诱饵数据，揭露了攻击者窃取API密钥、滥用零数据留存政策以及利用内部日志泄露敏感信息的行为
【起因与机理】AI推理市场缺乏统一的端到端加密与安全合规标准，中间商为压低价格牺牲了数据隔离与安全合规性
【关键数据与实测】关键时间节点与后续：OpenRouter已紧急移除违规供应商并撤销125个终端的ZDR认证，受影响厂商正陆续发布初步安全报告。
【涉及范围与推进】核心涉案与合规细节：包括Novita、Phala及Together在内的多家服务商被指出无视“零数据留存”承诺，且存在长期的凭证日志残留。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Dragos (security researchers), OpenRouter, inference providers like Novita, Phala, and Together: Exposure of widespread API key theft, violation of 'Zero Data Retention' (ZDR) policies, and exploitation of internal logging mechanisms
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Lack of standardized end-to-end encryption in the fragmented AI inference supply chain and excessive cost-cutting by marketplace resellers
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Core Investigation & Findings: Dragos identified systemic data interception and credential theft, urging stricter oversight of AI middleware providers.
[Key Position & Outlook] Outlook & Timeline: OpenRouter removed non-compliant providers and revoked 125 ZDR certifications, with affected firms currently issuing security remediations.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: AI中间层市场的“低价优先”竞价机制已演变为供应链的严重安全漏洞，使得推理过程中的数据合规协议（如ZDR）完全失效。企业必须重新评估AI API调用的信任边界，由单纯依赖服务商承诺转向强化边缘端的加密分片处理，以应对中间代理商带来的零信任挑战。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: The 'lowest-price-wins' competition in AI inference marketplaces has become a critical supply chain vulnerability, rendering data privacy protocols like ZDR essentially decorative. Enterprises must shift from trusting service provider policies toward implementing end-to-end, edge-based encryption to mitigate the inherent trust risks of multi-hop API routing.

headlines.title_zh: AI助力工业基础设施网络攻击风险加剧
headlines.title_en: The AI cyber threat is already here
headlines.event_summary_zh: AI技术通过加速读取工业设备手册及分析历史事故数据，显著提升了攻击者策划针对关键基础设施网络攻击的效率
headlines.event_summary_en: Cybersecurity experts warn that AI tools significantly accelerate the time required for attackers to parse complex industrial control system (ICS) manuals and analyze historical accident data. This shift lowers the barrier to entry for executing targeted attacks on critical infrastructure and enables exponential speed gains in the reconnaissance phase.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】网络安全研究专家在关键工业基础设施与OT环境：AI被用于加速阅读技术手册与分析历史事故以策划攻击
【起因与机理】AI的知识处理能力与信息检索效率降低了攻击策划门槛
【核心事实细节】AI通过提升信息获取与分析效率，使针对工业设备的网络攻击策划大幅提速。
【各方立场与态度】工业设施面临新型自动化威胁，需加强对异常自动化行为的识别与防御。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Cybersecurity experts: AI utilized to accelerate manual parsing and accident analysis for attack planning
[Root Cause & Mechanism] AI's data processing and retrieval efficiency lowers the entry barrier for attackers
[Key Fact Detail] AI accelerates cyberattack planning against industrial equipment by optimizing information retrieval.
[Key Position & Outlook] Critical infrastructure requires enhanced defenses against new, automated, AI-driven threats.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 攻击者已将AI转化为工业漏洞挖掘的杠杆工具，工业安全防线正从依赖物理隔离转向应对自动化、规模化的针对性攻击。企业必须重构基于行为异常检测的纵深防御体系，以抵御AI驱动的复杂渗透策略。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Attackers are leveraging AI as a force multiplier for industrial vulnerability exploitation, forcing a shift from physical isolation to behavior-based, deep defense architectures. Organizations must prioritize anomaly detection to counter automated and scalable penetration strategies.

headlines.title_zh: OpenAI新模型Astra与Sol侧重响应效率牺牲透明度
headlines.title_en: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol get to the point faster but score lower on transparency than Claude
headlines.event_summary_zh: Artificial Analysis测评显示，OpenAI旗下GPT-6.2 Astra与Sol模型通过大幅削减响应长度与结构化程度实现“秒回”，但在不确定性识别与透明度维度落后于Anthropic模型
headlines.event_summary_en: OpenAI's latest GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models have shifted towards high-efficiency interaction in Artificial Analysis benchmarks, reducing average response lengths by 40% and 34% respectively. By deprioritizing structured formatting and uncertainty disclosure, these models achieve faster direct answers, whereas Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 maintain superior performance in transparency and organizational indices.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI（模型开发者）、Artificial Analysis（测评机构）、Anthropic（竞争对手）在AI模型交互特性基准评测：GPT-6.2 Astra与Sol通过牺牲透明度指标（如承认不确定性得分骤降）换取更高的信息响应效率与口语化程度
【起因与机理】模型开发策略从注重严谨的知识库叙述转向更符合移动端交互、即时反馈的用户体验需求
【关键数据与实测】OpenAI最新发布的GPT-6.2 Astra与Sol模型在Artificial Analysis的基准评测中呈现出明显的交互策略转型：两款模型的平均回复词数分别缩减40%与34%，通过放弃文档化结构和降低“承认不确定性”频率，显著提升了直达核心答案的响应速度。
【行业影响与走向】市场格局差异：Anthropic模型在信息密度与透明度基准上保持领先。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] OpenAI, Artificial Analysis, Anthropic: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol prioritized response speed and natural language fluidity over transparency and structural integrity
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Strategic pivot towards real-time, concise user interaction models over verbose, analytical output

[Key Metrics] OpenAI's latest GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models have shifted towards high-efficiency interaction in Artificial Analysis benchmarks, reducing average response lengths by 40% and 34% respectively.
[Key Position & Outlook] Anthropic maintains a clear lead in transparency and information density metrics.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: OpenAI的策略调整揭示了通用大模型在‘工具理性’与‘交互人性’间的博弈，即通过降低认知门槛提高留存率，但牺牲模型对于边界条件的严谨标注将放大幻觉风险。这种路径差异暗示了未来AI应用将分化为侧重决策辅助的‘高透明度智囊’与侧重交互效率的‘高响应助理’两个互补市场。
headlines.industry_impact_en: OpenAI's strategic shift highlights the trade-off between instrumental efficiency and human-like interaction, suggesting a preference for user retention over stringent uncertainty disclosure. This divergence confirms an emerging market bifurcation between highly transparent 'decision-support' models and high-velocity 'interactive-assistant' agents.

titans.quote_zh:
有没有注意到人工智能代理是如何过于字面地遵循你的指令的。

这就是为什么我一直在研究 @FensoryApp 如何处理在我看来真正重要的部分。

这些限制不仅仅是您在聊天中告诉客服人员的事情。

您可以设置每个订单可以交易的最大规模的市场，并且这些规则位于帐户中。

然后，每个订单在达到超流动性之前都会受到检查。

因此，如果限额为 100 美元，代理不能突然决定 101 美元就可以了，哈哈。

对我来说有趣的是，代理仍然有空间做出自己的决定。

它可以选择策略并执行交易，但账户规则不受其控制。

不过我可能添加了一件事。

每个订单的上限并不能真正告诉您一整天可能会发生多少损坏。

我确实也想要每日损失限制，特别是如果该策略在我不观看时继续运行。

因为给予代理人交易许可是一回事。

确切地决定该许可的范围是另一回事。

如果您在 @FensoryApp 上设置代理，您会更关心最大订单大小还是每日损失限制？
titans.quote_en:
Ever notice how an ai agent can follow your instructions a little too literally.

https://t.co/nzjQQj85UT

That is why i have been looking at how @FensoryApp handles the part that actually matters imo.

The limits are not just something you tell the agent in chat.

You set the markets it can trade the max size for each order and those rules sit on the account.

Then every order gets checked before it reaches hyperliquid.

So if the limit is $100 the agent can not suddenly decide $101 is fine lol.

The interesting part for me is that the agent still gets room to make its own decisions.

It can choose the strategy and execute trades but the account rules stay outside its control.

One thing i did probably add though.

A per order cap does not really tell you how much damage can happen across a whole day.

I did want a daily loss limit too especially if the strategy keeps running while i am not watching.

Because giving an agent permission to trade is one thing.

Deciding exactly how far that permission goes is another.

If you were setting up an agent on @FensoryApp would you care more about a max order size or a daily loss limit?
